title: Rubio to accompany Trump during Philippines visit for ASEAN Summit
summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio is expected to accompany President Donald Trump during his visit to the Philippines for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

blocks.text: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio is expected to accompany President Donald Trump during his visit to the Philippines for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.
In a report by Bea Pinlac on "24 Oras" on Saturday, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez confirmed that Rubio would be traveling to the Philippines with Trump.
Trump is scheduled to arrive in the Philippines on Tuesday, November 17.

The US president's upcoming visit has drawn protests from various groups across the country. On Friday, university students staged a mass walkout from their classes to protest Trump's visit and the controversial Pax Silica initiative.
Other world leaders have already arrived in the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit, including Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney.
President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. has met with both Carney and Lula to discuss several bilateral agreements. —Jean Mangaluz/VBL, GMA News
